metadata.question: Did surface water extent increase along the Indus River floodplain in Pakistan between July 1, 2022 and August 28, 2022?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-1 GRD (SAR, cloud-free) VV band. Compare two periods near the given dates: 2022-06-25..2022-07-05 vs 2022-08-20..2022-08-28 over a corridor approximating the Indus floodplain within Pakistan. If no images, widen windows.
2. Masking strategy: SAR is cloud-insensitive; no cloud mask needed. Derive water via adaptive Otsu threshold on VV backscatter.
3. Logic: Check image collection sizes (C1). Count valid pixels after compositing (C2). Validate Otsu threshold; if fails, fallback to -17 dB; if still invalid, C3. Compare water areas; if increase exceeds max(5% of T1, 20 km²), answer Yes.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const pakistan = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017')
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Pakistan'))
      .geometry();
    // Approximate Indus River corridor by three rectangles, intersect with Pakistan
    const rect1 = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([66.5, 23.0, 69.5, 28.5], null, false);
    const rect2 = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([69.5, 28.0, 73.5, 32.5], null, false);
    const rect3 = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([71.0, 32.5, 74.5, 36.0], null, false);
    const studyGeom = ee.Geometry.MultiPolygon([rect1.coordinates(), rect2.coordinates(), rect3.coordinates()])
      .intersection(pakistan, 1);

    const t1a = {start: '2022-06-25', end: '2022-07-05'};
    const t1b = {start: '2022-06-20', end: '2022-07-10'};
    const t2a = {start: '2022-08-20', end: '2022-08-28'};
    const t2b = {start: '2022-08-15', end: '2022-09-05'};

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    function s1Col(start, end) {
      return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD')
        .filterBounds(studyGeom)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW'))
        .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV'))
        .filter(ee.Filter.or(
          ee.Filter.eq('orbitProperties_pass', 'DESCENDING'),
          ee.Filter.eq('orbitProperties_pass', 'ASCENDING')
        ))
        .select(['VV']);
    }

    async function getComposite(rangePrimary, rangeFallback, label) {
      let col = s1Col(rangePrimary.start, rangePrimary.end);
      let n = await col.size().getInfo();
      if (n === 0) {
        col = s1Col(rangeFallback.start, rangeFallback.end);
        n = await col.size().getInfo();
        if (n === 0) {
          console.log(`${label} Images: 0`);
          console.log('C1');
          return {tag: 'C1'};
        } else {
          console.log(`${label} Images: ${n} (fallback ${rangeFallback.start}..${rangeFallback.end})`);
          return {img: col.median().rename('VV'), n};
        }
      } else {
        console.log(`${label} Images: ${n} (${rangePrimary.start}..${rangePrimary.end})`);
        return {img: col.median().rename('VV'), n};
      }
    }

    function otsuThreshold(image, region) {
      const histDict = image.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.histogram({maxBuckets: 128, min: -30, max: 5}),
        geometry: region,
        scale: 1000,
        bestEffort: true,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      });
      const h = ee.Dictionary(histDict.get('VV'));
      const buckets = ee.Array(h.get('bucketMeans'));
      const counts = ee.Array(h.get('histogram'));
      const total = ee.Number(counts.reduce(ee.Reducer.sum(), [0]).get([0]));
      const sumAll = ee.Number(counts.multiply(buckets).reduce(ee.Reducer.sum(), [0]).get([0]));
      const cumsum = counts.cumsum(0);
      const sumcum = counts.multiply(buckets).cumsum(0);
      const nBins = ee.Number(counts.length());
      const from = ee.Number(1);
      const to = nBins.subtract(1);
      const counts0 = cumsum.slice(0, from, to);
      const counts1 = total.subtract(counts0);
      const w0 = counts0.divide(total);
      const w1 = counts1.divide(total);
      const mean0 = sumcum.slice(0, from, to).divide(counts0);
      const mean1 = sumAll.subtract(sumcum.slice(0, from, to)).divide(counts1);
      const between = w0.multiply(w1).multiply(mean0.subtract(mean1).pow(2));
      const maxVal = ee.Number(between.reduce(ee.Reducer.max(), [0]).get([0]));
      const idx = ee.Number(ee.List(between.toList()).indexOf(maxVal));
      const thr = ee.Number(ee.List(buckets.slice(0, from, to).toList()).get(idx));
      return thr;
    }

    const comp1 = await getComposite(t1a, t1b, 'T1');
    if (comp1.tag) return;
    const comp2 = await getComposite(t2a, t2b, 'T2');
    if (comp2.tag) return;

    // Pixel validation
    const totalCount = await comp1.img.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: studyGeom,
      scale: 1000,
      bestEffort: true,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('VV').getInfo();
    if (!totalCount || totalCount === 0) {
      console.log('Valid pixels (1km): 0');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    console.log(`Valid pixels (1km): ${totalCount}`);

    // 3. Processing: thresholds, water areas
    let thr1 = null;
    let thr2 = null;
    try {
      thr1 = await otsuThreshold(comp1.img, studyGeom).getInfo();
    } catch (e) {}
    try {
      thr2 = await otsuThreshold(comp2.img, studyGeom).getInfo();
    } catch (e) {}
    if (thr1 === null || !isFinite(thr1)) thr1 = -17;
    if (thr2 === null || !isFinite(thr2)) thr2 = -17;

    function waterAreaKm2(img, thr) {
      const water = img.lt(ee.Number(thr));
      const area = water.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: studyGeom,
        scale: 1000,
        bestEffort: true,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('VV');
      return ee.Number(area).divide(1e6);
    }

    const area1 = await waterAreaKm2(comp1.img, thr1).getInfo();
    const area2 = await waterAreaKm2(comp2.img, thr2).getInfo();

    if (area1 === null || area2 === null || !isFinite(area1) || !isFinite(area2)) {
      console.log('Areas invalid');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const delta = area2 - area1;
    const pct = area1 > 0 ? (delta / area1) * 100.0 : (area2 > 0 ? 100.0 : 0.0);

    console.log(`T1 thr(dB): ${thr1.toFixed(2)}, water_km2: ${area1.toFixed(1)}`);
    console.log(`T2 thr(dB): ${thr2.toFixed(2)}, water_km2: ${area2.toFixed(1)}`);
    console.log(`Δwater_km2: ${delta.toFixed(1)}, Δ%: ${pct.toFixed(1)}`);

    // 4. Final Answer
    const absMin = 20; // km2
    const relMin = 5; // %
    const increased = (delta > absMin) && (pct > relMin || area1 === 0);
    console.log(increased ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
